label: Doorstep Thank-You Notes
description: Loser leaves a handwritten one-line thank-you note on each league member's doormat. A photo of the stack of notes before delivery goes in the league chat.

label: Good Day, Sir
description: For one week, Loser greets every leaguemate he sees in person with a formal "good day, sir," and logs each greeting in the league chat.

label: Hello, Neighbor Walk
description: Loser waves and says "Hello, neighbor!" to everyone he passes on one ten-minute walk. A selfie from the end of the walk goes in the league chat.

label: Innuendo Swear Jar
description: For one week, every innuendo Loser posts in the league chat costs him $1 for the league pot. The winner posts a screenshot of the tally on Sunday.

label: 60-Second NFL Roll Call
description: After bedtime, Loser has 60 seconds to name as many NFL teams as he can, on video. The league fills in any he missed in the group chat.

label: Five Worst Decisions, Ranked
description: Loser posts a ranked list of his five worst fantasy decisions this season, with a one-line review of each. A screenshot goes in the league chat.

label: Winner's Jingle Performance
description: Winner picks a well-known jingle, and Loser sings it with full commitment in one uncut video. The video goes in the league chat.

label: Swipe-Left Lineup Award Speech
description: The winner presides while Loser accepts a cardboard award for "Most Likely to Swipe Left on a Winning Lineup" with a trembling speech on video. The video goes in the league chat.

label: Living Room Halftime Show
description: Loser performs a 90-second one-man halftime show in his living room: jumping jacks, high knees, and a spoken team chant. The uncut video goes in the league chat.

label: Two Minutes of Bad Juggling
description: Loser tries to juggle three oranges for two minutes in one take. The video, drops and all, goes in the league chat.

label: Five-Mile Weighted Night Walk
description: After bedtime, Loser carries a backpack with 20 lbs of pantry goods on a five-mile walk at an easy pace, stopping if anything hurts. A route screenshot and a photo of the loaded pack go in the league chat.

label: Candlelit Puzzle Slow Burn
description: Before the next draft, Loser completes a 1,500-piece puzzle by candlelight and posts a weekly progress photo in the league chat, narrated like a slow-burn romance.

label: Cereal Aisle Confessional
description: Loser films a 60-second tearful reality-TV confessional in the cereal aisle about how the winner ruined his life, whisper-crying to the camera. The video goes in the league chat.

label: 100 Push-Ups in a Day
description: Loser does 100 push-ups in one day, in as many sets as he needs, and posts a quick video of each set in the league chat.

label: 45-Minute Junk Drawer Sprint
description: Loser has 45 minutes to clear, wipe, and reorganize his messiest junk drawer or closet shelf. Before and after photos go in the league chat.

label: Winner's Smoldering Greeting
description: Winner picks a winking line like "we have to stop meeting like this," and for one week Loser opens every in-person hello with a leaguemate using it, in a smoldering whisper. He logs each use in the league chat.

label: Park Nature Documentary
description: At the neighborhood park, Loser delivers a 45-second hushed nature-documentary narration of whatever he sees, while a leaguemate films. The video goes in the league chat.

label: 150-Squat Certificate
description: Loser does 150 squats across one day and mails the winner a hand-drawn certificate with the set tally. A photo of the certificate goes in the league chat.

label: Winner's Movie Speech From Memory
description: Winner picks a famous movie speech, and Loser recites it from memory in front of a leaguemate who films it. The video goes in the league chat.

label: Memorized Ode to the Winner's Lineup
description: Winner writes a 12-line romantic ode to the winner's own starting lineup, and Loser memorizes it and delivers it in one uncut video with a rose between his teeth. The video goes in the league chat.

label: Daily 30 Before Coffee
description: For one week, Loser does 30 push-ups every morning before touching coffee or his phone, and posts a quick video check-in in the league chat each day.

label: Winner's 20-Minute Workout
description: Winner writes a safe 20-minute bodyweight workout in his own style, and Loser completes it after bedtime. A video of the final round goes in the league chat.

label: Three-Minute Stand-Up of Shame
description: Loser performs a three-minute stand-up bit about his worst moves of the season on a league video call, timed by a stopwatch. The recording goes in the group chat.

label: Romantic Card and a $15 Gift
description: Loser mails the winner a $15 gift with a ridiculous romantic card ("you complete me, and my waiver claims"). A photo of the card goes in the league chat.

label: Grocery Store ASMR Tour
description: Loser films a 60-second ASMR-style whisper tour of the cereal aisle in one uncut take. The video goes in the league chat.

label: Inflatable Costume Grocery Dash
description: Loser has 10 minutes to complete one lap of the grocery store in an inflatable costume while a leaguemate times him. The video goes in the league chat.

label: Winner's Biggest Fan, Face Paint
description: For one week, Loser joins every league video call in the winner's team colors in face paint with a foam finger. A screenshot from each call goes in the group chat.

label: Garage Glow-Up, Winner's List
description: Winner writes a 10-item cleanup list for Loser's own garage, and Loser finishes the whole list by Sunday after bedtime. Before and after photos go in the league chat, captioned like a romance novel.

label: Illustrated Apology Booklet
description: Before the next draft, Loser makes a bound 20-page illustrated "Official Apology to the Winner" booklet and presents it in a short ceremony. Photos of the pages go in the league chat as he finishes them.

label: Five-Minute Plank Ceremony
description: On a video call the winner presides over, Loser holds a five-minute plank with rests of up to 10 seconds, stopping if anything hurts. A screenshot of the finish goes in the group chat.

label: Three-Foot Trophy Commission
description: Winner names the trophy's theme, and Loser builds a three-foot trophy from cardboard, paint, and foil after bedtime, spending up to $20 on supplies. Build photos go in the league chat, and he hands it to the winner on Sunday.

label: Burpees With Winner's Love Script
description: Winner writes a cheesy romantic motivational script, and Loser does 60 burpees in sets of 10, reading a page aloud between sets. The uncut video goes in the league chat.

label: Late-Night Cape Run
description: After bedtime, Loser spends $15 on a ridiculous cape and wears it through one grocery run while a leaguemate films. The video and the receipt go in the league chat.

label: 15-Mile Day With Victory Speech
description: Before the next draft, Loser walks 15 miles in one day at an easy pace with breaks, posting a route screenshot every five miles, and ends with a one-minute victory speech to the winner on video in the league chat.

label: Front Yard Interpretive Dance
description: Loser performs a three-minute interpretive dance of the winner's best play in his front yard while a leaguemate films. The video goes in the league chat.

label: Roster Wedding Vows, Memorized
description: Winner writes a six-minute mock wedding vow and toast to Loser's roster. Loser memorizes it over the week and performs it from memory on a late video call, with the winner as officiant, and the recording goes in the group chat.

label: Chore Infomercial
description: Loser does a chore the winner names, at Loser's own home, narrating it like an overexcited infomercial host in one uncut video. The video goes in the league chat.

label: Wall Sit Landmark Tour
description: After bedtime, Loser holds a four-minute wall sit against a neighborhood landmark such as a fence or park wall, giving a tour-guide history of it while he shakes. The video goes in the league chat.

label: One-Man Season Recap Play
description: Loser performs a five-minute one-man play recapping his season with props and voices on a league video call. The recording goes in the group chat.

label: Sexiest Dad Alive Chore Round
description: Loser wears a hand-lettered "Sexiest Dad Alive" sash through a full round of household chores (dishes, laundry, vacuum). A photo of each chore goes in the league chat.

label: Handmade Champion's Cape
description: Before the next draft, Loser sews a felt champion's cape for the winner, spending up to $25 on materials, and mails it with a handwritten decree. Photos of the build and the finished cape go in the league chat.

label: Winner's Park Crab-Walk Course
description: Winner names a silly movement (bear crawl, crab walk, or skip) and a 100-yard course at a park. Loser completes it three times while a leaguemate films from a distance, and he can stop if he is uncomfortable. The video goes in the league chat.

label: Winner's Singing Telegram Tour
description: Winner picks a song, and Loser delivers a 20-second singing telegram to each leaguemate's doorstep while a leaguemate films. The video goes in the league chat.

label: Winner's Double-Meaning Phrase
description: Each day this week, the winner gives Loser a double-meaning phrase, and Loser works it naturally into a league-chat message. He posts a screenshot of each message each night.

label: Winner's 30-Day Task Calendar
description: Before the next draft, Loser completes a 30-day challenge made of daily tasks the winner writes (push-ups, a chore, a compliment, a cold shower), with a daily check-in in the league chat.

label: Winner Mascot Costume Delivery
description: Loser builds a full-body cardboard mascot of the winner (up to $30 in supplies), wears it, and delivers a handwritten trophy to the winner's door while a leaguemate films. The video goes in the league chat.

label: Winner's Five-Dish Meal Prep
description: Loser buys $50 of groceries and spends a Sunday meal-prepping five dishes from the winner's recipe list. A photo of each plated dish goes in the league chat.

label: Three-Course Dinner With Love Poems
description: Before the next draft, Loser pays about $50 to host a three-course dinner for the league in a bow tie, introducing each course with a romantic poem about the food. A photo of each course goes in the league chat.

label: Fake-History Neighborhood Tour
description: Loser leads the league on a one-mile walking tour of the neighborhood in a full tour-guide costume, inventing absurd history for each landmark. A leaguemate films, and the video goes in the league chat.

label: Midnight Kitchen Reset
description: After bedtime, Loser does a total kitchen reset: every cabinet front, the oven, the fridge interior, and the floor, with a grocery run for supplies. Before and after photos go in the league chat.
